prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: ecommerce category banner and product-lineup image
Primary request: a clean studio lineup of exactly four distinct unbranded Vietnamese café drinks: (1) classic creamy milk tea with black tapioca pearls, (2) bright orange lemongrass fruit tea with fresh orange slice and a subtle lemongrass stem, (3) deep jade matcha macchiato with a smooth ivory foam cap and fine matcha dust, (4) pale lavender-free natural taro milk with small taro cubes and pearls; each drink visibly different and appetizing
Scene/backdrop: warm off-white seamless studio tabletop with a very subtle jade stone strip near the bottom
Subject: four clear takeaway cups, no straws, aligned in a loose editorial lineup with separation between every cup
Style/medium: premium realistic commercial beverage photography, clean modern Vietnamese tea shop mood
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape; full cups visible; varied heights and slight depth stagger; useful negative space between drinks and around the group, especially at left and right; no cup cropped
Lighting/mood: soft natural daylight, gentle shadows, fresh, handcrafted, clean
Color palette: cream, caramel, mandarin orange, deep tea jade, muted natural taro beige-pink; never vivid purple
Materials/textures: condensation on clear cups, translucent ice, glossy pearls, airy macchiato foam, real citrus
Constraints: exactly four drinks; no labels, logos, brand marks, text, watermark, hands, people, extra beverages, real brand resemblance
Avoid: purple, neon, gradients, clutter, busy props, identical drinks, floating fruit, CGI/plastic look, distorted cups, excessive shadows
